series: Climate Fiscal Policy Briefs · Section 6: Modular Upgrades · October 2026
title: Upgrade the Model Where Policy Needs It

slides.title: Upgrade the Model Where Policy Needs It
slides.subtitle: Five modular upgrades to the Climate Policy Assessment Tool: section 6 in ten slides
slides.message: Keep CPAT's core small enough to audit, and answer each new question with a module that reads its outputs: one carbon-price scale, the EU border charge, the cost of clean capital, one activity layer, and growth, revenue and debt.
slides.author: Stephen J. Stretton · writing in a personal capacity

slides.title: Five questions the core cannot answer, five modules that can
rows: What is our policy mix worth as a carbon price?
What will the EU border charge cost exporters?
What will clean capital cost, and should the budget pay?
How do we link CPAT to our other models?
What does the program do to growth and debt?
slides.note: Each reads CPAT's prices, fuel use, emissions and revenue, adds one piece of economics, and states its method in a few equations.
